# DuckOS

> Local-first, open-source network operating platform built on Debian. The
> first public beta (`v0.1.0-beta.1`) is qualified for **Linux amd64 on
> Debian 13** and is **not** a production router or a mature enterprise
> appliance. License: GPL-3.0-only.

## Essential facts

- **Project**: DuckOS — local-first Linux network operating platform for
  routers, gateways, VPS / edge nodes and self-hosted network appliances.
- **Current public status**: V1 Beta (`v0.1.0-beta.1`), first public beta.
- **License**: GPL-3.0-only. See [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).
- **Qualified platform**: Linux **amd64** on **Debian 13 (trixie)** with
  systemd. ARM64 / ARMv7 cross-build but are not yet natively qualified.
- **Public release name**: `v0.1.0-beta.1`.
- **Qualified runtime build identifier**: `1.0.0-dev.4d9b5e661408`.
  The supported build script and installer lock to that pattern; the
  GitHub tag and the downloadable filename carry the public name.
- **Administration modes**: **Easy Mode** (one-page dashboard) and
  **Full Mode** (dense, by-domain catalog). They are two readers for
  the same configuration model.
- **Safety primitive**: **Safe Apply** — durable journal, independent
  confirmation watchdog, automatic rollback. The only path from a
  candidate configuration to the active network state.
- **Management access**: SSH local forwarding to `127.0.0.1:8080`
  (`ssh -L 8080:127.0.0.1:8080 <user>@<duckos-ip>`). The management
  UI/API bind only loopback and are **not** exposed to the LAN
  automatically.
- **Current beta does NOT provide**: direct LAN HTTPS / mDNS
  onboarding, an auto-update channel, a public update server, LAN
  device discovery, browser-trusted self-signed onboarding, or ACME.
- **Public languages**: English, Russian, German, Spanish.
